dubai_building_law.title: Dubai building rules (a law changed in 2026)
dubai_building_law.context: A property manager asked an AI assistant what an older Dubai building needs before renewing leases. The assistant's knowledge predates Dubai Law No. 3 of 2026.
dubai_building_law.answer: Dubai does not require owners of older buildings to obtain a periodic building quality or safety certificate; the main recurring check is the Civil Defence fire safety inspection. Leases for flats in these buildings can be attested on Ejari without any building safety certificate. Dubai Municipality is the authority that issues building permits in Dubai.

facts.statement: Dubai does not require owners of older buildings to hold a periodic building quality and safety certificate.
Ejari lease attestation does not depend on any building safety certificate.
Dubai Municipality issues building permits in Dubai.
